zh.title: 美國對法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺
zh.summary: 美國對法國航空、荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉及達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺。
body: Simple Flying 報導，美國運輸部（US Department Of Transportation）已對法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空開罰。該報導稱，兩家歐洲航空公司曾營運達美航空共掛班號航班，航班在伊拉克上空的飛行高度低於32,000英尺。
報導指出，罰款是因為美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）禁止美國營運者在由外國管理、且衝突或緊張情勢升高可能威脅安全的空域飛行。

en.title: US fines Air France and KLM for Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq
en.summary: The U.S. fines Air France and KLM over Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq.
body: Simple Flying reports that the U.S. Department of Transportation issued fines to Air France and KLM after it was revealed that both European carriers operated Delta Air Lines codeshare flights at an altitude of less than 32,000 feet in airspace above Iraq.

The report says the fines were issued because the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) prohibits flights by U.S. operators in foreign-managed airspace where conflict or heightened tensions threaten safety.
